<|im_start|>assistant
Lenovo's acquisition of Motorola has impacted its overall business strategy and product offerings in several ways. 

Firstly, it has enabled Lenovo to expand its mobile business and gain a significant presence in the smartphone market, which was previously dominated by Samsung and Apple. Motorola's innovative smartphone technology and design, combined with Lenovo's manufacturing and distribution capabilities, have helped the company become a major player in the smartphone industry.

Secondly, the acquisition has allowed Lenovo to diversify its product offerings and enter new markets. Motorola has a strong brand recognition in North America and Latin America, which has helped Lenovo increase its market share in these regions. Additionally, the acquisition has allowed Lenovo to enter the wearable technology market, thanks to Motorola's smartwatch offerings.

Finally, the acquisition has allowed Lenovo to increase its focus on innovation and product design. Motorola has a reputation for innovative technology and design, which has helped Lenovo improve its product development process and bring new and exciting products to the market.

Overall, Lenovo's acquisition of Motorola has had a significant impact on its business strategy and product offerings, allowing the company to expand its mobile business and enter new markets, while also increasing its focus on innovation and design.<|im_end|>

3. Competition: Lenovo faced tough competition from other smartphone manufacturers, especially in the highly competitive smartphone market of China. They also faced challenges in markets where Motorola's brand presence was weak.

El partido terminó 3 a 3 gracias a un pibe Messi que se consagró con un hat trick empatando el partido en el minuto 90.
El Real Madrid salió en busca del partido desde el principio y Van Nistelrooy abrió el marcador con un ramate cruzado apenas empezó el encuentro. Pero el Barça no se quedó atrás, lo fue a empatar y Messi definiío cruzado en un mano a mano con Iker Casillas para empatar.
A los 13 Van Nistelrooy puso el 2 a 1 con un penal y demostraba que el Madrid se quería quedar con el derby. Y nuavamente lo mismo, el baulgrana a buscar el partido con Messi y Ronaldinho con mucha profundidad por las bandas.
Y a los 28, Ronaldinho remata dentro del área y el rebote le queda a Lionel, que con un fortísimo tiro empata el partido. 2 a 2 y un partido impensado.
Pero llegó lo peor para el Barça cuando Oleguer lo fue a buscar a Fernando Gago y lo golpeó fuerte en campo madrilista sobre la izqueirda: segunda amarrilla y el local con 10.
El merengue lo aprovechó y lo fue a buscar en el segundo tiempo y lo único que impedía que el Madrid estuviera ganando era Victor Valdes, que le tapó tres jugadas claras a Van Nistelrooy.
Pero a los 72, la figura del Madrid Guti tira un centro desde un tiro libre y Sergio Ramos cabecea de espaldas para poner el 3 a 2.
Y así era, los blancos sorprendían al Barça en su cancha y se llevaban un respiro inmenso para su ciudad, pero cuando el partido se acababa, Messi tomó la pelota a 10 metros del área grande, dejó tirado en el piso a Ivan Helguera con una corrida en diagonal a toda velocidad y luego definió perfecto y cruzado ante Casillas para empatar el partido.
Capello sigue sin ganar en el Camp Nou, aunque esta vez estuvo cerca, hasta que Messi decidió empatarlo. El Real Madrid tiene un poco de aire para pensar en lo que sigue, y el Barcelona se recuperó justo para seguir prendido en el campeonato.
Ambos equipos no llegaban en su mejor momento, pero por suerte, se pudo ver un buen juego en el Camp Nou, con los dos grandes españoles jugando a un muy buen nivel.

Your 5-month-old baby will still need to nurse or bottle feed approximately six times per day. However, it's the ideal age to start introducing your baby to solid foods. For best results, it is imperative to expose your baby to a variety of safe, healthy foods that are not likely to upset her stomach. Feed your baby one food at a time for about three days in a row before you introduce another new food.
Feed your 5-month-old baby a single-grain barley, rice or oat baby cereal. Cereals such as these are easily digestible and do not contain allergens, such as wheat. Mix just a teaspoon or two of the cereal with breast milk, formula or water until it forms a semi-liquid, soup-like consistency. Scoop just a small amount of the cereal mixture onto the tip of a soft baby spoon; offer it to your baby after you nurse or feed him.
Vegetables are healthy; they provide your baby with the vitamins and minerals she needs to grow up strong. In addition, they are not as likely to cause an allergic reaction like some other foods. Begin with mashed or pureed vegetables with a mild taste; introduce carrots and sweet potatoes. When your baby becomes adjusted to these flavors, add stronger-tasting vegetables, such as peas, string beans, kale, broccoli, cauliflower, Brussels sprouts and spinach.
Fruits are naturally sweet and easy to digest, making them an ideal food for a 5-month-old baby. Puree or finely mash apples, pears, bananas or peaches. You can also purchase jarred fruits at grocery stores. After your baby gets used to the bland fruits, add tart or sour fruits to your baby’s diet, such as cherries and plums. Just be sure to remove any pits; puree them completely as you would with other fruits.
Stew meats like chicken, pork and beef; puree them in a blender or baby food mill. Meat has iron and protein, which your young baby needs to grow; other protein sources include tofu, soy, nuts and beans. Protein provides a baby with the strength to learn valuable skills like crawling and eventually walking. Don’t be afraid to add flavor to the meats. For example, Matthew Amster-Burton on the Babycenter website suggests stewing the meat in ginger, soy sauce, orange juice or lime juice.
